purpose: Predeclared numerical convergence design for verification configurations; not a production Prusament PLA annealing campaign
evidence_boundary: All solver fields are genuine MAPDL outputs. Verification constants and loading choices are numerical fixtures unless an exact source is named. Passing these studies does not supply missing production material or boundary evidence.

structural_mesh.model: 60 mm x 4 mm plane-stress cantilever, unit thickness, source-backed 23-branch isothermal Prony spectrum at 65 degC
structural_mesh.load_history: 0 to -0.001 N over 0-1 s; hold to 31 s; unload to zero by 32 s; recover unloaded to 62 s
responses: maximum top-edge residual displacement at 62 s
95th-percentile interior von Mises residual stress at 62 s

thermal_mesh.model: 10 mm plane wall with Stage 8 constant-property fixtures and ramp-hold-cool convection history

contact_mesh.model: 10 mm x 4 mm plane-strain block with a 0.020 mm rigid-stop gap and a declared uniform expansion fixture

acceptance.mesh_pair_definition: delta_q = abs(q_fine - q_medium) / abs(q_fine) * 100 percent; the same calculation is repeated for extra-fine versus fine
acceptance.zero_denominator_rule: No percentage is reported when the selected denominator is zero; absolute change and its units remain reported.
